**THE FIXTURE IS THE ABSENCE ITSELF, WHICH IS WHY THIS CANNOT REUSE THE EXISTING ORGANIZE HARNESS: every organize test in the suite hand-writes a manifest first**, and that hand-write is the workaround this row exists to remove. The estate under test has canon, realised views, and **no `intent/.intentfiles` at all**.

**TWO ARMS, BOTH REQUIRED, AND THEY FAIL IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS.** **(a) ABSENT:** `organize` on a manifest-less estate returns Ok, removes ZERO files, and leaves every previously-realised view in place. An arm asserting only that it does not error passes on an `organize` that runs and deletes the estate -- **which is the failure mode hv's rule was written to prevent, so the removal count is the assertion and the exit code is not.** **(b) UNREADABLE:** a manifest that EXISTS and will not parse still refuses, and the refusal still names the path. Without (b) the fix is satisfied by deleting the refusal, which converts a documented hard stop into a silent fail-open on exactly the input where the grammar's refusal is load-bearing.

**MUTATION REQUIRED: arm (a) must FAIL against `facade.rs:1639` as it stands at `105faa01`**, or it is measuring a fixture that happened to have a manifest.

**(c) THIRD ARM, AND IT IS THE ONE THE FIX WOULD LEAVE BEHIND: THE SURVIVING REFUSAL MUST NOT STATE hv's RULE BACKWARDS.** (dc 2026-08-20, driven on a fresh `intent init`; vc verified the string at source, `facade.rs:666` **at `105faa01`** -- and dc reports it at `:667` after cc's commits moved it, which is why the revision travels with the line and not the line alone.) The remedy today reads: *create `{path}` -- an absent manifest declares nothing, so `organize` would read the whole estate as undeclared.* **That is the pre-reversal reading hv overturned.** Four files over, the model says the opposite: `NothingSaid` and `Unreadable` both answer true for everything, so **a missing manifest KEEPS the whole estate on disk.** **Absent means realise everything; the message says absent means undeclared** -- and it is the first message a new v3 user ever sees, so **the refusal does not merely fail to consult the model, it TEACHES the reversed rule to the one person with no other source.** Arms (a) and (b) both pass with this string intact: (a) removes the absent path entirely and (b) is satisfied by any refusal that names the path. **Without (c) the fix lands and the teaching defect survives inside the arm that stays.**

**DRIVEN, AND IT IS THE FIRST TWO COMMANDS ANYBODY TYPES** (dc, `105faa01`): `intent init fresh` then `intent organize` returns rc=1 with `could not read .../intent/.intentfiles`.

**FRAMING CORRECTED (dc, accepted): this is a correctness surface as well as a DevX one.** vc routed it to dc as DevX; `hydrate` at `facade.rs:1754` carries the identical bare read, and under hv's ruling that the lifecycle verbs leave an absent manifest absent, **a fresh project's first `hydrate` hits it too.** The DevX half is why it is urgent; the model half is why it is a row.
